subject: CSA submission segmentation & staging plan
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@blueharbor.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Blue Harbor Audit Team <audits@blueharbor.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: CSA questionnaire — staging request and upload preferences

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is our working copy of the CSA/CAIQ spreadsheet (CSA_questions_v1.xlsx). For this audit window we need the CAIQ answers plus a per-control artifact package (logs, config snapshots, attestations) delivered in staged batches rather than one monolithic zip. Two asks:

1) Can you provide a control-by-control index that maps your answers to the CSA control IDs and names (a single CSV manifest is fine)?
2) Can you stage artifact bundles by control-family (e.g., Identity, Data Protection, Platform Security) and provide pre-signed S3 links or a Drive folder with short-lived access?

Deliverables we expect: per-control answer, owner name/attestation, and at least one representative artifact or log sample where applicable. Ideally we get the first tranche (high-risk controls) within 48 hours to begin validation.

Let me know if you prefer an S3 bucket or Drive link pattern and whether the files will include redacted samples (we can accept redacted logs).

- Emily
Emily Zhao
Senior Auditor, Blue Harbor Financial
emily.zhao@blueharbor.com
[Attachment: CSA_questions_v1.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@blueharbor.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — staging request and upload preferences

Thanks Emily — we can do staged bundles.

Soojin/Marissa, can you pick up ownership for the tranche splits and get the first bundle ready? Proposed plan:

- Tranche A (48h): Identity & Access Management controls + attestations (high priority)
- Tranche B (72h): Data Protection + storage/log samples (redacted where necessary)
- Tranche C (end of week): Platform & Network controls + config snapshots and runbooks

I'll provide a csv manifest (control-bundle-manifest.csv) that maps our CSA answers to control IDs and includes an owner, short description, and expected artifact filename(s). We will upload artefacts to our audit staging bucket s3://redwood-inference-audit-staging/blueharbor/2027-11/ and share pre-signed links (24h expiry) in a small text file (s3-staging-links.txt).

Soojin — can you confirm owners for IAM controls and whether we have redacted log samples available? Marissa — can you draft the manifest template and the first set of answers for Tranche A based on CSA_questions_v1.xlsx?

I will coordinate delivery to Emily and set up a 30-min sync after the first tranche is uploaded.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Internal attachment placeholders: control-bundle-manifest.csv]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@blueharbor.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — staging request and upload preferences

Rishi — confirmed. Quick status update and clarifications: 

- Owners: IAM controls will be owned by Priya Natarajan and Kim Park (I've looped them in on a separate internal task). For attestations, we'll use a short owner statement file (owner_attestation_<control>.md) signed off by the control owner.
- Log samples: For Data Protection controls we can provide redacted object access logs and KMS rotation snapshots. Redaction will remove PII and customer identifiers; include a short redaction.md per file explaining what was removed.
- Artifact format: prefer pre-signed S3 links — easier for automation. We will place artifacts in the bucket with folder structure by tranche and control ID: /blueharbor/2027-11/tranche-A/CC-01-identity/
- Automation: we have a small script that exports compressed log slices and applies the standard redaction filter; I will attach the execution manifest as part of Tranche B.

Planned uploads:
- Tranche A upload ETA: Mon Nov 15 10:00 PST (IAM answers + attestations, ~15 files)
- Tranche B upload ETA: Tue Nov 16 12:00 PST (Data Protection artifacts + redaction manifests)
- Tranche C ETA: Thu Nov 18 EOD (Platform/network configs & runbooks)

Attachments I will include with Tranche A: control-bundle-manifest.csv, owner_attestation_template.md

If Blue Harbor wants the manifest formatted differently, tell us and we will adapt.

Soojin Lee
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stubs: control-bundle-manifest.csv, owner_attestation_template.md]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSA questionnaire — staging request and upload preferences

Emily — we uploaded Tranche A to the staging bucket and included the manifest and short owner attestations. Links below (pre-signed, 24h expiry). Full manifest attached as control-bundle-manifest.csv.

Staging links (expires 2027-11-17 16:48 PST):
- s3://redwood-inference-audit-staging/blueharbor/2027-11/tranche-A/control-bundle-manifest.csv (pre-signed link in s3-staging-links.txt)
- s3://redwood-inference-audit-staging/blueharbor/2027-11/tranche-A/CC-01-identity/owner_attestation_CC-01.md
- s3://redwood-inference-audit-staging/blueharbor/2027-11/tranche-A/CC-02-auth-logs/redacted_auth_log_sample_20271031.gz

Attachments: control-bundle-manifest.csv, s3-staging-links.txt

Next steps:
- Please confirm you can access the Tranche A links and whether the manifest format works for your ingestion pipeline.
- We'll aim to push Tranche B by Tue Nov 16 12:00 PST as noted — Soojin will upload the redacted log samples and include the redaction.md per file.

If you'd like a short screen-share to walk the team through the manifest and folder layout, I'm available Wed Nov 17 08:00–11:00 PST.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: control-bundle-manifest.csv, s3-staging-links.txt]
